conflicts.description: Meurice and Sanghi appointment day. The 8-K says the board appointed both on December 4, 2024, effective immediately (cover: earliest event 2024-12-04). Both Forms 3 give an event date of 2024-12-05. Kept 2024-12-04 (the 8-K).

Lip-Bu Tan's start year. The 2026 proxy shows 'Director Since: 2022', but he resigned on 2024-08-19 and rejoined as CEO on 2025-03-18 (the same proxy's bio says so). Recorded as two memberships: 2022-09-01 to 2024-08-19 and 2025-03-18 onward.

Reed Hundt's name in the 2001 vote results. The Q2 2001 10-Q lists 'R. Hunt' among the directors elected on 2001-05-24; the 2001 proxy nominated 'Reed E. Hundt' as the only new nominee, and the 2019 proxy gives 'Director Since: 2001'. Treated as a misspelling of Hundt.

Goetz's Palo Alto Networks board start. The 2026 proxy says 'since 2004'; his 2019 appointment 8-K says he has been on that board 'since April 2005'. Kept the 2026 proxy wording in bio_other_public_boards; this does not affect Intel tenure.

open_questions: Yeary's start as Chair (and Ishrak's end) is dated only 'January 2023' in the 2023 proxy; no 8-K reports the change, so the day is unknown.

Alyssa Henry's Lead Independent Director role is dated only December 2024 to March 2025. It plausibly ran 2024-12-01 to 2025-03-18 (tied to Yeary's Interim Executive Chair term), but no filing states those days.

Committee assignments after the 2026-05-13 annual meeting are not disclosed in any filing reviewed (through 2026-08-28). In particular, Barratt had no committees in the 2026 proxy and his assignments as Chair are unknown, and so is whether committees were reshuffled after Yeary left.
The 2026 proxy lists Yeary with no committee assignments (the M&A Committee he chaired was disbanded in February 2025), so no committee rows are recorded for him.
Exact IPO day (1971) is not stated in any filing reviewed; listed_since_year is 1971 per Intel's 2003 DEFA14A.
Pre-2020 departures (e.g., Aneel Bhusri, 2019-11-01) and pre-2020 roles of directors who left before 2020 are out of scope and not recorded.
Independence for Hundt before 2019 and for Yeary 2009-2018 is assumed continuous from the 2019+ determinations; earlier proxies were not reviewed for those years.

coverage.method: Roster from the 2026 DEF 14A and the 2026-05-13 Item 5.07 results (11 elected). Every 8-K filed after the proxy (Item 5.02 filings of 2026-04-03 and 2026-04-24 are officer-only) and every Form 3/4 through 2026-08-28, the latest filing in the EDGAR submissions feed, reviewed. All 11 directors filed Forms 4 as directors in 2026.

Every DEF 14A 2019-2026 and every 8-K with Item 5.02 or 5.07 from 2019 to 2026 reviewed; annual-meeting slates compared year over year (2019: 10, 2020: 9, 2021: 9, 2022: 10, 2023: 12, 2024: 13, 2025: 11, 2026: 11). Every director Form 3 since 2019 checked. Departures dated from 8-K Item 5.02 or, for directors who did not stand, from the Item 5.07 meeting date.

Pre-2020 seats only for directors serving on or after 2020-01-01, dated from appointment 8-Ks (2009-2019), Forms 3, the 2001 proxy and 10-Q (Hundt), and 2019-2020 proxies. Directors who left before 2020 (e.g., Aneel Bhusri, Brian Krzanich, David Pottruck, Charlene Barshefsky) are not recorded.
